preamble.title: stellaris/vault
preamble.description: Stellaris per-user Preprod vault — Phase 1 of the on-chain migration

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

anyOf.title: State
anyOf.description:
The vault's aggregate ledger. Exactly one per vault, identified on-chain
 by the state-thread token it carries (see `stellaris/thread`).

 Fee fields (Stage 5): the management fee is an annual rate in basis
 points charged on accounted assets, prorated by wall-clock time and
 settled by MINTING shares to the treasury rather than paying lovelace
 out. `treasury_shares` is the treasury's unclaimed slice of
 `total_shares`; `last_fee_time` is the POSIX ms up to which fee has
 already been charged.

fields.title: receipt_policy
fields.description:
Stage 6: the receipt minting policy bound to this vault, written once
 at bootstrap and immutable afterwards. Every `Deposit` must mint, and
 every `Withdraw` must burn, exactly the depositor-share delta under
 this policy with token name = `asset_id`; every other action must move
 zero receipts. Must be a 28-byte script hash.

fields.title: entry_fee_bps
fields.description:
Stage 7 (revenue): per-action fees, in basis points, charged on the
 deposited amount and on the gross redemption respectively. The
 withheld lovelace never leaves the vault — it is credited to the
 treasury as shares, exactly like the management fee. Both start at 0
 at bootstrap and can only move through `SetFee`, within the caps in
 `stellaris/shares`.

vault/VaultRedeemer.title: VaultRedeemer
vault/VaultRedeemer.description:
Typed redeemer. `Withdraw` is the only current action; adding variants
 later gives us a clean upgrade path without changing the type signature.

anyOf.title: Deposit
anyOf.description: Add lovelace, mint shares at the current price.

anyOf.title: Withdraw
anyOf.description: Burn `shares` from a position, take at most `redeem_value(shares)`.

anyOf.title: Accrue
anyOf.description:
Operators add `amount` lovelace of yield; depositor share count
 untouched, but the accrued management fee is minted to the treasury
 first, so the fee is never charged on yield that has not landed yet.

anyOf.title: SetPaused
anyOf.description: Operators halt deposits and accruals. Withdrawals stay open.

anyOf.title: RotateCommittee
anyOf.description:
Operators replace the signing committee. Requires M-of-N of the OUTGOING
 committee; the incoming committee must itself be valid. Nothing else
 about the vault may move in the same transaction.

anyOf.title: SetFee
anyOf.description:
Governance-executed fee change. Settles the management fee accrued under
 the OLD rate first, then writes the new rate triple. Capped by
 `shares.max_fee_bps`, `shares.max_entry_fee_bps` and
 `shares.max_exit_fee_bps`.

anyOf.title: ClaimFee
anyOf.description: Treasury cashes out part of its accrued fee shares at the current price.
